text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. To help me understand your condition, could you please describe the timing and frequency of these shooting ear pains? Also, did you experience any specific complications during or immediately after your tympanoplasty surgery?

text: 25-year-old female. The patient has a history of polycystic ovarian syndrome, depression, and chronic bilateral ear infections. She underwent right ear tympanoplasty 12 weeks ago. She describes her job as stressful and mentions poor sleep quality.
